thread:
Alex Chen: folks — quick sync on the battlecard + webinar narrative. need something that actually helps SDRs argue vs cloud AI and infra vendors. short thread for decisions :wave:
Tessa Ortiz: totally. goal: 1 pager for SDRs + a 12-min slot in the webinar that highlights 3 customer scenarios where serving matters more than model lip service.
Samir Patel: +1. can we lead with concrete numbers from the latency/cost benchmark? e.g. '5x cost savings at 99th pct' type claims need source.
Maria Gomez: I can pull bench numbers but need to know which test workloads to surface. do we want 'chatty multi-turn' and 'high-throughput embeddings' or one hero workload?
Alex Chen: hero workload = multi-tenant chat at 2k rps + embeddings background load. show cost/latency tradeoffs vs managed cloud endpoints and vs raw infra (self-host).
Jamal Reed: for messaging vs infra vendors we should call out ops overhead: "time-to-production, patching, and KV cache tuning" — not just $$ per token.
Tessa Ortiz: agreed. high-level narrative: "You don't win on a model. You win on predictable inference." then 3 bullets: latency SLOs, predictable unit economics, and rollback/fallback policies.
Samir Patel: can we add one short customer quote (anonymized) about a rollout that regressed when they moved to a cheaper endpoint and regained SLA on our Dedicated offering?
Maria Gomez: I have a quote from FinanceApp (anonymized) — "moved to cheaper endpoint, 30% more tail latency, caused timeouts for webhook flows". ok to use if anonymized.
Alex Chen: yes use anonymized. Samir can you drop a one-sentence datapoint under the hero workload: e.g., "at 2k rps, cloud-managed endpoints + autoscale had 2.3x higher p95 latency during peak tests" — make sure it's reproducible.
Samir Patel: will run one more controlled test tomorrow and post the numbers. ETA EOD PST.
Tessa Ortiz: copywriting: I'll draft the SDR one-pager and the webinar 12-min script. need the benchmark table (2 rows, 3 cols) and the customer quote by EOD tomorrow to finalize.
Alex Chen: routing/inbound: ops-bot, remind — how should webinar attendees be routed? SDR inbound flow or product demo queue?
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar intake currently routes to marketing@ then triaged by SDR queue. Suggested change: add a "high-intent" tag for attendees who select "Dedicated" or "Private" during signup.
Jamal Reed: that tag is perfect. SDRs need a 2-step play: immediate 24h email with battlecard CTA + schedule playbook with solutions engineer for Dedicated prospects.
Maria Gomez: for sequencing: 1) 24h nurture email with one-pager, 2) targeted follow-up by SDR (if tag=high-intent), 3) book SE call within 5 business days.
Tessa Ortiz: webpage copy / UTMs — please use these UTMs for campaign tracking: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=serving_vs_models. For high-intent links add &intent=dedicated.
Alex Chen: add to battlecard a cheat-sheet rebuttal matrix vs typical cloud claims: "we're easier to use" / "we have the model" / "we have scale" — short counters with 10-15 word line items.
Samir Patel: I'll draft technical counters (latency, predictable pricing, KV cache) tonight and share.
Maria Gomez: logistics: who will present the 12-min slot? Alex? Tessa?
Alex Chen: happy to lead the slot, Tessa does the customer narrative, Samir does the 1-slide benchmark tease.
Tessa Ortiz: noted. I'll also make a 1-slide "how to route leads" for SDRs.
Jamal Reed: final ask: can marketing ops add an alert to the CRM when webinar attendee clicks "request private deployment" link? we want real-time routing.
ops-bot: Created ticket #OPS-4321 for CRM webhook + high-intent tag automation. ETA 3 days.
Alex Chen: perfect. next steps recap: Samir run controlled bench + post numbers; Maria confirm anon quote; Tessa draft one-pager + webinar script; ops-bot/ops deliver CRM routing. Back here EOD tomorrow for final signoff. :rocket:
Tessa Ortiz: copy plan: I'll do a short version for SDRs (1 page) and an expanded reference doc for solutions. share by 5pm PT.
Samir Patel: bench queued — running now, will post logs + raw table.
Maria Gomez: confirming quote permission from legal, will update status in thread.
Alex Chen: thanks team. if anyone has objections to the messaging hierarchy speak now, otherwise I'll lock the slide and share the public-facing blog draft after bench numbers land. :thumbsup:
